title: Quest
description: A quest (#184): a player-facing name and an ordered list of steps, each one condition met a number of times. One file per quest, named after its id. Each player's progress is kept in their profile by the quest's id, so an id is never reused or changed once shipped.

id.description: Stable, never reused: lowercase words joined by underscores.

steps.description: The steps, in the order the player goes through them.

condition.description: dominated: a wild monster this player dominated. opened: a treasure chest this player got loot from.

species.description: On a dominated step, the species id it asks for; any species when left out.

count.description: How often the condition is met to finish the step.
